content: If NmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE, Nm_PncBitVec- torTxIndication (<NM-channel>, PncBitVectorPtr <buffer to provide the unfiltered PNC bit vector>) is called and no requests for synchronized PNC shutdown are pending on the given NM-channel, then Nm shall copy the unfiltered PNC bit vector for internal PNC requests of the given NM-channel to the buffer indicated by PncBitVectorPtr .
